feature_policy.reason: Data_v4 YOLO ablations showed no stable independent-test gain; several families were also highly redundant. RGB remains the control and all Data_v5 additions must earn retention on train/valid only.

data_v5_yolo_screen.combination_reason: Three-seed combination averaged 0.62 pp below the best single feature and was positive in only 1/3 seeds.
data_v5_yolo_screen.next_stage: Completed: formal training stopped at epoch 218; frozen candidate was evaluated on test exactly once

final_deployment_decision.decision: archive MCARI candidate; keep deployed website model unchanged
final_deployment_decision.test_reuse_policy: locked: do not evaluate this candidate on the held-out test again and do not use test results for feature tuning

notes: This compact candidate set does not alter the deployed R,G,B,NDVI,NDRE model contract.
Standard BSI and NDTI remain unavailable because DJI P4M has no SWIR band.
MCARI, MTCI and PSRI use the closest P4M band mapping and require empirical validation.
NDVI_GRAD and NDVI_STD5 are project spatial features, not standard spectral indices.
The held-out test split was not used for feature selection and was evaluated exactly once after candidate freeze.
The RGB+MCARI candidate did not pass deployment criteria; the website remains on R,G,B,NDVI,NDRE.
